description: Turn a commit batch, sprint, or SHIPPED_LOG entry into player-facing release notes for ReGen Civics. Produces forum post, newsletter blurb, Twitter thread, changelog entry, or all four. Voice-matched, voice-clean (no em-dashes, no AI tells), and clear about which changes affect players directly vs. infrastructure work. Triggers on: "release notes", "what's new", "changelog", "release post", "ship update", "sprint summary for the community", "what shipped this week", "tell the community what landed", "publish release", "update post", or any request to communicate recent changes to players, investors, or the wider community.
